name: Nicol Bolas
description: Nicol Bolas is an ancient elder dragon and planeswalker, a 25,000-year-old schemer known as one of the greatest threats to the Multiverse, and the twin brother of Ugin.

description_citations.text: "Nicol Bolas". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Ugin", section "Birth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Nicol Bolas is an ancient elder dragon and planeswalker, a 25,000-year-old schemer known as one of the greatest threats to the Multiverse, and the twin brother of Ugin.

citations.text: "Nicol Bolas". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Ugin", section "Birth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Nicol and Ugin hatched together and witnessed the murder of their sister Merrevia Sal, after which Nicol decided that being the hunter was better than being prey.

citations.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.
"Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

bio.text: He manipulated humans and then the dragon clans against each other, winning the Elder Dragon War, and his spark ignited in envy of Ugin.

citations.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "The manipulations of Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "Elder Dragon War and ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Elder Dragon War", section "The last clash". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He later killed Ugin on the Meditation Plane, and on Madara he slew the empress and ruled as God-Emperor for 150 years until Tetsuo Umezawa destroyed the Imperial Shrine and killed him.

citations.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Confrontation on the Meditation Plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Alara he planned the convergence of the shards to feed on its mana and restore his lost power, took Sarkhan Vol as a sworn servant, and was banished from the plane by Ajani.

citations.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Sarkhan Vol", section "Alara Unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Tarkir he defeated Ugin with Yasova's help, and he sent Sarkhan to the Eye of Ugin to release the Eldrazi, arranging for Sarkhan, Jace and Chandra to converge there.

citations.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Defeating Ugin again". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

bio.text: On Amonkhet he corrupted the plane, posed as the God-Pharaoh and built the Trials to make an army of Eternals, and on his return he defeated the Gatewatch.

citations.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Amonkhet (plane)", section "Under Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He then hired Vraska with the offer of the Golgari guildmastership, used the Immortal Sun to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica, and cast the Elderspell to harvest their sparks.

citations.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.
"Nicol Bolas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Elderspell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Liliana turned the Dreadhorde against him, Niv-Mizzet impaled him with Hazoret's spear, and Bontu harvested all his sparks, after which Ugin took his body, stripped him of both his names and imprisoned him in the Meditation Realm.

citations.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "Nameless and imprisoned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Alive and free: after Elspeth's attack let him remember his name, he escaped the collapsing Meditation Realm into the Multiverse, and Ajani later says he escaped through an Omenpath.

citations.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Rediscovered". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nicol Bolas", section "Rediscovered". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chromium hides among humans during the Elder Dragon War and survives.
timeline.quote: he was one of the few survivors of the War

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas sows discord among the heirs and inspires the king's son to overthrow his father.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas immediately set about sowing discord, suspicion, ambition, and mistrust among them.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas lures the two other heirs and their armies up the birth mountain, where they fight, and burns the unguarded temple.
timeline.quote: Nicol flew down to the unguarded temple and burned it and its acolytes to the ground.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas poisons the king's second wife with words of greed and vanity; she kills her husband and marches on the other heirs.
timeline.quote: She killed her husband and marched on the other heirs.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The king's son and second wife stab each other and die; the dragon-killers are dead and Bolas takes rule over their people.
timeline.quote: And so, the dragon killers were dead, and Nicol Bolas assumed the reign over their people.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Elder Dragons of Dominaria fight the Elder Dragon War, which kills most of their kind.
timeline.quote: a conflict that shook the plane of Dominaria and killed most of their kind

citation.text: "Elder", section "Elder Dragons of Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Descendants of Vaevictis raid Bolas's lands, are defeated, then Vaevictis and his siblings defeat Bolas's army, which retreats.
timeline.quote: Bolas' army suffered a shattering defeat and had to retreat into the mountains

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "Start of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's sorcerers kill Ravus and Bolas overpowers Lividus's mind and turns him against Vaevictis, allowing escape.
timeline.quote: the sorcerers of Bolas' army managed to kill Ravus

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "Start of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas manipulates the dragon clans against each other.
timeline.quote: Manipulating the many dragon clans, he turned them against each other.

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "The manipulations of Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The war spreads across the seas, and Arcades Sabboth joins, listening to Bolas's whispers.
timeline.quote: Even the wise Arcades Sabboth threw his might into the great war

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "The spreading of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the last clash on Jamuraa, Ugin's intervention saves Sabboth; Bolas's spark ignites in rage and envy and he planeswalks away, ending the war.
timeline.quote: Only the unexpected intervention of Ugin prevented the ultimate defeat of Sabboth.

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "The last clash". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Emperor marshals the kentsu and sets Elsdragon to kill the leaders of Kusho and Argenti.
timeline.quote: setting Elsdragon to the task of killing the leaders of Kusho and Argenti .

citation.text: "Marhault Elsdragon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ramses Overdark takes control of the kentsu after being spared by Bolas.
timeline.quote: Ramses Overdark then assumed control of the kentsu after being spared by Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Marhault Elsdragon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol and Ugin hatch together and witness the murder of their sister Merrevia Sal.
timeline.quote: Nicol expressed outrage, but Ugin convinced him not to aid her

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas starts the Dragon-killers' War by tricking dragon hunters into a feud and takes over as supreme leader.
timeline.quote: After starting the Dragon-killers' War by tricking the dragon hunters into a bloody feud between several factions, Bolas took over as supreme leader.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's attempt to use Ugin shocks him into igniting his spark.
timeline.quote: This mental shock caused Ugin's planeswalker's spark to ignite

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas wins the Elder Dragon War and his own spark ignites in envy of Ugin.
timeline.quote: in rage and envy of Ugin's newly-revealed planeswalker status, Bolas's own spark ignited

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Elder Dragon War and ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Overdark to reclaim the rebellious Edemi Islands; Overdark plots to kill Tetsuo, but his minions and serpent generator are defeated.
timeline.quote: When the Edemi Islands rebelled against the empire, Bolas first sent Overdark to reclaim them.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Madara-Edemi War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas, impressed by his ambition, names Overdark imperial regent.
timeline.quote: Bolas then awarded Overdark with the title of imperial regent.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Imperial Regent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin strips Nicol Bolas of his names to prevent summoning him from the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: Ugin stripped Nicol Bolas of his names to prevent summoning him from the Meditation Realm

citation.text: "Summon", section "Mirage and onwards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas lures Rakka Mar with the promise of more magical power, and she uses her influence among Jund's human war clans to promote greater Life Hunts.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas saw the potential in Rakka Mar immediately and lured her with the promise of more magical power.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakka Mar gains dark powers of elementalism from her bond with Bolas.
timeline.quote: In return, Rakka gained dark powers of elementalism the likes of which she had never felt before.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakka saves Sarkhan Vol and presents her master Nicol Bolas to him.
timeline.quote: Later, she saved Sarkhan Vol and presented to him her master, Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas usurps power in Madara and becomes god-emperor.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas usurps the power in Madara , becoming its new god-emperor.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa ends the Madara-Edemi War, slaying Nicol Bolas among others.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo Umezawa slays Xira Arien , Jorgan Hage , Ramses Overdark and Nicol Bolas , ending the Madara-Edemi War .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The emperor charges Elsdragon with conquering the Edemis and punishes Umezawa and Overdark, placing Umezawa under Elsdragon and keeping Overdark out of the campaign.
timeline.quote: He charges Elsdragon with conquering the Edemis.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elsdragon, Tetsuo and Overdark meet on the Meditation Plane and invoke the emperor, who destroys the Greater Realm of Preservation just by blinking.
timeline.quote: Elsdragon and Tetsuo meet Overdark on the Meditation Plane and the three of them invoke the emperor, who destroys the Realm just by blinking.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The emperor reveals himself as Nicol Bolas and makes Overdark imperial regent.
timeline.quote: He makes Overdark the imperial regent

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Teferi return to Dominaria; Teferi gives up his spark to seal the rift over Shiv while Jhoira secretly holds his spark in a powerstone.
timeline.quote: Teferi gave up his planeswalker's spark to seal the time rift over Shiv

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends the kentsu to the Edemis and forces Tetsuo to join; Tetsuo's loyalty weakens after the kentsu's dishonorable behavior and a talk with Kolo Meha.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo's willingness to follow the emperor weakened.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Second journey to the Edemis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Overdark has Elsdragon killed and is made regent; Tetsuo, finding Ayesha poisoned, Tor wounded and Kei killed, renounces his title and swears vengeance.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo renounced his title of champion and swore vengeance.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Second journey to the Edemis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo flees to the Meditation Plane and destroys the Imperial Shrine with Meteor Hammer; denied his planeswalker powers, Bolas is defeated.
timeline.quote: Denied his powers as a planeswalker, Bolas was defeated by Tetsuo.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Champion against emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meha and the kittens destroy Kentsu forces sent to lure Tetsuo; Bolas robs Overdark of his body in punishment.
timeline.quote: Bolas robs Overdark of the use of his body

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo kills Overdark in the Imperial Shrine after Bolas's spell is deflected onto him.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo strikes first and kills Overdark.

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo draws Bolas to the Meditation Plane, destroys the shrine with Hage's hammer, and kills Bolas.
timeline.quote: and Tetsuo kills him

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Bolas's urging Domri Rade defeats Borborygmos by setting waves of beasts on him; Borborygmos loses the Gruul's respect.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Domri Rade challenged and defeated the aging Borborygmos by setting waves of beasts on the cyclops

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's plan nears fruition; Kaya and Dovin usurp the Orzhov and Azorius while Vraska, Domri and Ral fall under his sway.
timeline.quote: allowing for non-native planeswalkers Kaya Cassir and Dovin Baan to usurp control

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies and kills Isperia under Bolas' orders.
timeline.quote: She was petrified and killed by Vraska , leader of the Golgari Swarm , under Bolas' orders.

citation.text: "Sphinx", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav cleanses his guild of Bolas's agents and pledges the Dimir to the alliance opposing Bolas at the guild summit.
timeline.quote: he pledged his guild to the alliance that planned to oppose Bolas

citation.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas seals the Madara rift using Leshrac as a sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas sealed the rift at Madara using the unwilling Leshrac as a sacrifice.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska falls under the mental control of Leshrac, who hopes to use her Phage powers against Bolas.
timeline.quote: unknowingly fell under the mental control of the insidious Leshrac

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Madara Leshrac ambushes Jeska, strips her Phage legacy and encases her in stone when she refuses to fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Leshrac encased her in stone to keep her from interfering

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas frees Jeska and tells her the Otarian rift cannot be closed.
timeline.quote: Bolas freed Jeska but assured her that the Otarian rift could not be closed

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Madaran rift Leshrac strips Jeska of Phage's powers and attacks Nicol Bolas, paralyzing him and rotting his body.
timeline.quote: Leshrac and Bolas battled both by spells and claw

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac and Bolas fight from world to world, pieces of the dragon falling on several planes.
timeline.quote: Walking from world to world, Leshrac and Bolas fought

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas impales Leshrac, reveals he already defeated Night's Reach, traps Leshrac in the true mask and uses it to close the Madaran rift, ending him.
timeline.quote: effectively ending the Walker of the Night's existence

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas slays the Empress of Madara and reigns as God-Emperor for 150 years.
timeline.quote: eventually slew the then-Empress of Madara

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa destroys the Imperial Shrine with Bolas's body inside.
timeline.quote: Using the Meteor Hammer spell, Tetsuo destroyed the Imperial Shrine while Bolas's physical body was inside

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa defeats and kills Bolas on the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: Bolas was defeated and killed by Umezawa.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Madaran Emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas escapes the rift and is reborn using Venser's latent spark.
timeline.quote: he was able to finally escape his prison and be fully reborn into the physical world

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats Teferi in a duel and tortures him with his touch.
timeline.quote: he tortured him with his mind-shattering touch and ripped his body to pieces

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats Leshrac and imprisons him in a mask.
timeline.quote: the latter was defeated after an epic battle and was imprisoned in the mask of the Myojin of Night's Reach

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas and a demonic leviathan fight the first planeswalker battle on Dominaria, destroying a third of the continent and causing the first temporal damage.
timeline.quote: Their battle destroyed one-third of the continent and caused the first temporal damage to the plane.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Madaran rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas closes the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac.
timeline.quote: The rift was closed second to last by Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Rift", section "Madaran rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas sacrifices Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara.
timeline.quote: sacrificing Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "The Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns to Dominaria and gives up his spark to seal the Shiv time rift after losing to Bolas.
timeline.quote: Teferi gave up his Planeswalker's spark to seal the time rift over Shiv

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Teferi's return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas sacrifices Leshrac to seal the Madaran rift.
timeline.quote: sacrificed Leshrac

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A disembodied voice tricks Venser and uses his and Radha's latent sparks to regain a body, revealing itself as Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: revealing itself to be Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi duels Bolas and is easily defeated, but convinces Bolas of the rifts' dangers and Bolas leaves, swearing vengeance.
timeline.quote: Bolas decides to leave, swearing vengeance on those who had imprisoned him

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sensei Ryu takes hold of Venser's mind and uses his will and spark to re-enter the material world as Bolas.
timeline.quote: Ryu took hold of Venser's mind and used his will and spark to re-enter the material world in full dread glory

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi challenges Bolas to a duel and is demolished; Radha talks Bolas out of taking more than their guard Aprem's life, and Bolas departs with a threat to Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: with a dire threat against the inhabitants of Kamigawa , Bolas departed

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace defects from the Infinite Consortium and joins Liliana to dethrone Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Jace defects from the Infinite Consortium and joins with Liliana Vess to dethrone Tezzeret

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas fights Ajani and is driven from Alara during the Conflux.
timeline.quote: Bolas fights Ajani Goldmane and an avatar of himself, and is driven from the plane.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the beaches of Madara the Myojin of Night's Reach offers Leshrac a copy of her mask, and Leshrac accepts the bargain to fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Leshrac accepts the bargain.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac duels Bolas, drains his black mana, defaces the Talon Gates and decays Bolas's body with Phage's corrosive touch.
timeline.quote: Neither planeswalker can noticeably harm the other until Leshrac defaces the Talon Gates

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas reveals he had been playing Leshrac, skewers him with his tail and traps his essence with the original mask.
timeline.quote: Skewering Leshrac with his tail, the dragon uses the mask to drain and trap Leshrac’s essence, winning the duel.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas restores Jeska, uses Leshrac's trapped essence to close the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac, and departs Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Bolas then uses Leshrac’s trapped essence to feed and close it, killing the defeated planeswalker.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin brings Nicol Bolas to the Meditation Plane wrapped in his wings; the Blind Eternities injure and blind Bolas.
timeline.quote: Ugin was able to bring Nicol Bolas to the Meditation Plane wrapped in his wings

citation.text: "Planeswalker (lore)", section "Planeswalking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani summons the essence of Bolas's soul to fight Bolas, and the two dragons vanish.
timeline.quote: he summoned the essence of Bolas's soul to fight for him

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Alara Unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Alara, Sarkhan swears allegiance to Bolas and exchanges blood with him.
timeline.quote: Upon that spot, Sarkhan swore his allegiance to Bolas and exchanged blood with the dragon

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Alara Unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan's mind unravels after he sees Bolas absorb the Maelstrom and be defeated by a duplicate avatar.
timeline.quote: Seeing his master defeated caused something within Sarkhan to snap, and his mind started to unravel.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Alara Unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Nicol Bolas, who promises power in exchange for servitude.
timeline.quote: who promised him power in exchange for servitude

timeline.summary: Ugin and Sarkhan reunite and discuss how Bolas manipulated Sarkhan and how he changed Tarkir's history.
timeline.quote: Ugin and Sarkhan reunited

citation.text: "Crucible of the Spirit Dragon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains his history: Ugin's spirit whispered to him, Bolas sent him to the Eye, and he later traveled back in time to save Ugin.
timeline.quote: When I stepped through I traveled back, before the dragons died, and tipped the scales of history.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan names Bolas as the one who sent him to the Eye to release the Eldrazi, and Ugin contains him briefly in a sphere of force before releasing him.
timeline.quote: He wanted it opened, the devourers released. He never told me why.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Sarkhan she follows a vision given by Bolas, and Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies off.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies away.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Bolas strikes down Ugin, Sarkhan wraps Ugin in a hedron cocoon, and is whisked back to an altered present; the dragon tempests intensify.
timeline.quote: Bolas strikes Ugin down as Sarkhan tumbles into the snow.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace fails a confrontation with Nicol Bolas, who overpowers his mind, and Tezzeret punishes him.
timeline.quote: Bolas mentally overpowered Jace, and Tezzeret punished him brutally for the failure

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas reveals Tezzeret's sanctum; the attack on the Iron Tower fails and Jace is captured.
timeline.quote: The attack on the Iron Tower failed, however, and Jace was captured.

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana confesses her motives to Jace: she needs the Consortium to escape her demon pact, and Bolas brokered her freedom.
timeline.quote: she needed the Consortium to break out of her pact with four demon lords

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas deems Liliana's failure a breach and offers service for freedom, which she rejects; he takes Tezzeret's broken body to rebuild.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret’s broken body, which he began rebuilding for his designs

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas brokers Liliana's deal with four demons.
timeline.quote: Bolas then brokered a deal with the four demons who would give Liliana her youth and a fraction of her old power back, in exchange for servitude.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas manipulates Chandra and sends Sarkhan to the Eye of Ugin to release the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Bolas sent Sarkhan to the Eye and manipulated the pyromancer Chandra Nalaar into arriving at the same time.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he knows Jace was one of three planeswalkers who opened the Eye, manipulated by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: You, a pyromancer, and a dragonspeaker. Planeswalkers all. You opened the Eye.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Vraska becomes employed by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska becomes employed by Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch confronts Nicol Bolas and is soundly defeated.
timeline.quote: When the Gatewatch confronts Nicol Bolas , they are soundly defeated.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas takes control of Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas takes control of Liliana Vess .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: In Emrakul's presence Liliana wonders whether seeking not to die was the wrong goal, and recalls Josu, Bolas and the Chain Veil as her worst moments.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had been pursuing the wrong goal

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace recommends going straight to Amonkhet to confront Bolas.
timeline.quote: Jace recommended traveling directly to the plane

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The revolt turns to reform; martial law ends, Baral is arrested, and Ajani joins the Gatewatch, who deduce Bolas is behind Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Ajani officially joined the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas takes Tezzeret into his service.
timeline.quote: Bolas offered him power in exchange for servitude, which Tezzeret accepted.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Seeker's Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret usurps Bolas's consortium; Jace later defeats Tezzeret as part of a plan Bolas agreed to.
timeline.quote: after he defeated Tezzeret in a duel and crushed the artificer's mind

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas uses the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and to transport his Eternals.
timeline.quote: Bolas would later use the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and later to transport his army of Eternals during the War of the Spark.

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls working for Bolas and turning Jace against Tezzeret, and Jace wrecking Tezzeret's mind on Ravnica four years ago.
timeline.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Tezzeret is working for Bolas to pay a debt.
timeline.quote: "Oh," Liliana breathed. "Oh. You're here for Bolas."

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana pins Tezzeret under her heel and forces him to reveal Bolas is on Amonkhet, home of the demon Razaketh.
timeline.quote: "Razaketh," he gasped.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana's briefing on Tezzeret and Amonkhet leads the Gatewatch to discuss stopping Bolas, whom Liliana says controls and may have created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: "Bolas controls the place completely. As far as I know, he created it."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals he once defeated Bolas in the Maelstrom, warns against going to Amonkhet and asks them to gather allies first.
timeline.quote: "Give me time to get some of those friends together.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas warns that fear is the last thing one puts faith in.
timeline.quote: You will fully understand fear when you discover it is the final thing you put your faith in.

citation.text: Cower in Fear (Modern Masters 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes there are gods on Amonkhet, in the world of Bolas.
timeline.quote: There are gods on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Impact" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra reveals the God-Pharaoh's return and the Hours begin when the sun rests between the horns, any day now.
timeline.quote: "The Hours will begin when the sun rests between the horns. I'd estimate any day now."

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: In an old alley, Nissa sees carved glyphs showing eight gods and a recently added horns sigil, concluding Bolas corrupted rather than created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas didn't create this world , she realized, he corrupted it.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and they resolve to learn what he changed and to speak with Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas must have come and gone only a few decades ago.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana lounges in a shaded tent, served by mummies, thinking of her hunt for Razaketh and of Nicol Bolas, who brokered her demonic contracts.
timeline.quote: Razaketh would make three.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana says they have met the Horned One, and Temmet has the mummies choke her in rage.
timeline.quote: We've met him, actually,

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Seeing through the illusions, Nissa witnesses a vision of a dark snake's shadow swearing to drain every world, starting with Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: For what I require, I would drain every world.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa recognizes that Kefnet is made of corrupted leylines, and weaves a spell that adds a new fiber of mana to them, altering him so he no longer wants to destroy her.
timeline.quote: She pulled it, and added a new fiber of mana to its mix.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is surprised to find perfection on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: The one thing the Gatewatch didn't expect to find on a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas was perfection.

citation.text: Open into Wonder (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Temmet notes that some refuse to appreciate the God-Pharaoh's gifts.
timeline.quote: there are those who refuse to appreciate all that the God-Pharaoh provides for us.

citation.text: Time to Reflect (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ukhat tells initiates to take comfort in the God-Pharaoh's presence.
timeline.quote: you can feel the presence of the God-Pharaoh. Take comfort in that.

citation.text: Splendid Agony (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Acolytes walk along the Hekma, staring at the horrors the God-Pharaoh's barrier keeps at bay.
timeline.quote: staring out at the ravenous horrors kept at bay by the God-Pharaoh's barrier

citation.text: Protection of the Hekma (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Accounting of Hours foretells the God-Pharaoh tearing down the Hekma at the Hour of Promise.
timeline.quote: When the Hour of Promise arrives, the God-Pharaoh will tear down the Hekma

citation.text: Winged Shepherd (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The inhabitants of Amonkhet train all their lives for the Trials of the Five Gods and prepare for the God-Pharaoh's return.
timeline.quote: They train their entire life for a chance to face the Trials of the Five Gods and join the elite ranks of the Worthy

citation.text: "Amonkhet", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas and meets fierce resistance in the desert and the city.
timeline.quote: When The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas, they meet with fierce resistance in the desert

citation.text: "Amonkhet", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas corrupts a pre-existing plane, kills every being old enough to walk, overtakes the gods, seals three away and brainwashes five to steward the plane.
timeline.quote: He sealed three of the gods away, outside the Hekma and left behind five gods to steward the plane until his fateful return.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas engineers a world where inhabitants reach physical perfection before killing each other in the Trials, to create an army of Eternals.
timeline.quote: Bolas's goal was the creation of an army of Zombie warriors known as Eternals

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Under Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's return in the Hour of Devastation kills most of the gods, leaving Hazoret, the Scarab God and the Locust God.
timeline.quote: After Bolas's return to the plane during the Hour of Devastation , the majority of the gods were killed.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Amonkhet's angels join the God-Pharaoh's hordes in laying waste to the plane during the Hour of Devastation.
timeline.quote: their true loyalty to the God-Pharaoh came to light, as they joined his hordes in laying waste to the plane

citation.text: "Angel", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Amonkhet the Gatewatch confronts Bolas and is soundly defeated, scattering; Jace is trapped on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: When they confronted the dragon, they were soundly defeated.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats the Gatewatch; Gideon is severely wounded, loses his sural and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Gideon was severely wounded, lost his sural, and barely managed to planeswalk away.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas takes over the God Trials, holding the population of Naktamun in a never-ending state of exercise.
timeline.quote: Bolas took this tenet and perverted it to hold the population of Naktamun in a never-ending state of exercise.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The afterlife promised to the worthy dead is revealed to be transformation into Eternals.
timeline.quote: This "afterlife" was revealed to be the transformation into an Eternal .

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas crushes Jace's mind and Jace planeswalks away to avoid mind-death.
timeline.quote: Jace's mind was crushed, and he instinctively planeswalked away to avoid mind-death.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana betrays the Gatewatch and flees Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Liliana betrayed her friends and fled to another plane

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Most of the gods of Amonkhet die when Bolas returns and ushers in the Hour of Devastation, leaving only Hazoret.
timeline.quote: Most of the gods died when Bolas returned and ushered in the Hour of Devastation, leaving only Hazoret to guide the survivors of Naktamun.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas imprisons and warps three gods to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.
timeline.quote: Three other gods were imprisoned and warped by Bolas to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is defeated by Bolas on Amonkhet; Nissa is saved by Gideon and flees.
timeline.quote: Nissa was mentally overwhelmed by Bolas after she found out that he controlled the leylines of the plane.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas curses the Amonkhet sphinxes, banning them from communicating, after his mind control fails against them.
timeline.quote: he placed them under a curse, banning them from communicating with other creatures in any way.

citation.text: "Sphinx", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon tears the cartouche from his neck, resolving to strike down Bolas.
timeline.quote: I tore the cartouche from my neck, dropping it on the ground before me.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In a ruined shrine they find the word Trespasser freshly carved beneath the God-Pharaoh's symbol.
timeline.quote: Trespasser.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut finds a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument and sees the God-Pharaoh named Trespasser.
timeline.quote: The walls of the shadowed chamber spoke of the God-Pharaoh's first arrival on Amonkhet

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut realizes that the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser who caused the calamity rather than saving the plane, and resolves to warn everyone.
timeline.quote: He caused it.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut dares to ask whether Hazoret herself is mistaken and appeals to the god of compassion she once was before the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: Any tiny sliver of a memory of that time before the God-Pharaoh?

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Sixty years earlier, the dragon arrives from another world with only days of magic left to put his plan in motion.
timeline.quote: He had days.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The gods of Amonkhet fight the dragon outside the Hekma, and Oketra's arrows fail to harm him.
timeline.quote: The arrow hit the dragon's side, and he laughed.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon fractures Kefnet's mind in two, and Kefnet falls.
timeline.quote: The dragon tipped his chin and fractured Kefnet's mind in two.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: With Kefnet down, the Hekma wavers and the dragon bursts through it.
timeline.quote: the hole widened enough for the dragon to burst through.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon, protected by shifting half a step from reality, lands on the tallest tower and channels a spell.
timeline.quote: The dragon landed atop the tallest tower, closed his eyes, and began to channel a spell.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon dissipates every mortal old enough to walk, leaving only infants and the gods in shock.
timeline.quote: every mortal old enough to walk dissipated into the sky.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and Oketra flee to a mausoleum and gather the orphaned children as the dragon follows.
timeline.quote: Hazoret began gently picking up as many children as she could.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon breaks the seal and blanks the minds of Hazoret and Oketra, who fall defeated.
timeline.quote: the minds of the two gods went utterly blank.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon takes three gods for himself and corrupts the leylines of the remaining gods to bind them to him and to forget their origins.
timeline.quote: he returned to the surface and took three of the gods for his own.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon raises the enchanted dead as caretakers and repurposes an elite sacrificial ceremony into the endless Trials, setting the second sun to move on his schedule.
timeline.quote: He spelled the second sun to move as he was ready

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon builds a throne and a horned monument, and plants a promise of his return in the gods and the people.
timeline.quote: he made a promise to return

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Decades later, the second sun settles between the horns and the dragon comes to collect his hoard.
timeline.quote: The time had come for the dragon to return to collect his hoard.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas boasts that he has created entire worlds and extinguished twice as many.
timeline.quote: I have created entire worlds and extinguished twice as many.

citation.text: This World Belongs to Me (Archenemy: Nicol Bolas Schemes, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The story recounts the God-Pharaoh's creation myth, in which he forged five gods and set the Trials and the second sun.
timeline.quote: And so the great God-Pharaoh forged the gods.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: As the poison unbinds Bolas's magic, Rhonas remembers the true history of the dragon, the corrupted gods, and the original eight.
timeline.quote: The great lie of the God-Pharaoh.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas names Nicol Bolas with his dying breath and recognizes the scorpion god as one of his corrupted brothers.
timeline.quote: This god was once one of the original eight

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra concludes it is the absent God-Pharaoh's fault and saves two children from mummies.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh who was not here.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret burns locusts from the God-Pharaoh's throne and prays for his return.
timeline.quote: She prayed to the God-Pharaoh for his return.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A rift in the sky above the throne tears open and Nicol Bolas, the golden God-Pharaoh, emerges.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh had arrived.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The God-Pharaoh smiles at the destruction and unleashes black flames that consume the cheering mortals.
timeline.quote: a deluge of black flames streaked down, consuming everything it touched.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret shields the mortals with sand and flame and realizes the God-Pharaoh brings only destruction.
timeline.quote: He rains destruction upon his people, his children.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu kneels, hails Nicol Bolas by name and declares her servitude, revealing she has served him and culled dissenters.
timeline.quote: I have culled dissenters from all the crops

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas commands Bontu to kill her sister, and Bontu blasts Hazoret with dark energy.
timeline.quote: Kill your sister.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and she remembers Bolas's deception.
timeline.quote: And suddenly, Hazoret remembered everything.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Hazoret and drops her at Bolas's feet, then Bolas blasts Bontu, calling her usefulness ended.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised one claw—and blasted Bontu with a bolt of dark energy.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas leaves to find the scarab god as undead swarm and drag down Bontu.
timeline.quote: flying toward the gate and the waiting scarab god.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit sees the dragon God-Pharaoh and realizes he is no impostor but the being they served.
timeline.quote: This dragon is not an impostor. This dragon is our God-Pharaoh.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit hurls Oketra's spear at the dragon, but he freezes it and it snaps; he calls her useful only in a different world and walks away.
timeline.quote: you might have been useful.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The gate to the afterlife opened and the people prostrated themselves in the light of the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: the gate to the afterlife opened, and the people were prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh

citation.text: Hour of Revelation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas taunts Gideon Jura for playing the protector.
timeline.quote: how easy it must be to play the protector when you think yourself untouchable

citation.text: Gideon's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas tells Jace he expected disappointment.
timeline.quote: I had hoped for more from you, Jace. But I expected as much.

citation.text: Jace's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas tells Liliana he can take away all the power she has gathered.
timeline.quote: All the power you have gathered for yourself, Liliana, I can take away.

citation.text: Liliana's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas mocks Chandra's fire.
timeline.quote: Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?

citation.text: Chandra's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas tells Nissa he would gladly kill the soul of the world again.
timeline.quote: The soul of this world is gone, Nissa, and I would gladly kill it again.

citation.text: Nissa's Defeat (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas declares to the Gatewatch that everything on Amonkhet exists or perishes at his whim.
timeline.quote: Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch.

citation.text: Hour of Devastation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas declares his work on Amonkhet complete.
timeline.quote: My work here is complete. The people have done everything required of them.

citation.text: Merciless Eternal (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas declares the plane has outlived its usefulness.
timeline.quote: This place has outlived its usefulness.

citation.text: Doomfall (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace wonders what Bolas's plan is for the Eternals.
timeline.quote: If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?

citation.text: Eternal of Harsh Truths (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that Bolas remade the plane in his image and holds the advantage.
timeline.quote: Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here.

citation.text: Strategic Planning (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Djeru loses faith, declaring the God-Pharaoh lied.
timeline.quote: Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied.

citation.text: Djeru's Renunciation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut rallies survivors to fight for tomorrow whether they believe the God-Pharaoh tested or betrayed them.
timeline.quote: If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!

citation.text: Life Goes On (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bontu died wanting only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.
timeline.quote: To the last, Bontu wanted only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.

citation.text: Bontu's Last Reckoning (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas culled the plane of its adults before building Naktamun.
timeline.quote: Bolas culled the plane of its adults in order to rebuild it for his own designs.

citation.text: Moaning Wall (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The God-Pharaoh was revealed to have built a factory to produce an army of Eternals.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh's benevolence concealed the factory he created to produce an army of Eternals.

citation.text: Frontline Devastator (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Second Sun reached its final position, heralding Bolas's return.
timeline.quote: As the Second Sun glided into its final position in the sky

citation.text: Wasp of the Bitter End (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Angels stripped former initiates of their cartouches.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh's angels stripped former initiates of their cartouches

citation.text: Crook of Condemnation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa urges others to see that Bolas's power on the plane is not absolute.
timeline.quote: Bolas's power on this plane can't be absolute.

citation.text: Woodland Stream (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Hour of Revelation reveals the God-Pharaoh as a malevolent dragon and the survivors flee into the desert.
timeline.quote: the survivors fled into the desert, leaving the destroyed city behind to forge a new destiny

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge; Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden defeat him, and Hazoret gives them her spear.
timeline.quote: Hazoret gave them her spear, reassuring Samut about the condition of Amonkhet's population

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bontu reveals she secretly helped Bolas conquer Amonkhet, betraying her plane and fellow gods.
timeline.quote: Bontu revealed that she had secretly helped Nicol Bolas conquer Amonkhet

citation.text: "Bontu", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas orders Bontu to kill Hazoret; she defeats her, then Bolas betrays and strikes Bontu down.
timeline.quote: Bolas betrayed Bontu without hesitation and struck her down

citation.text: "Bontu", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is defeated by Bolas on Amonkhet and Chandra, badly wounded, planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Chandra was severely wounded and had to abandon her friends by planeswalking away.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God and Locust God join in Bolas's plan; the Gatewatch, Hazoret, Samut and the faithful fight the Eternals.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch , Hazoret , Samut , and the remaining faithful fought to repel the crypt's unleashed legions

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Chandra visits the crypt, destroys a stay band of Eternals and obliterates the statue of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: then obliterated the massive statue of Nicol Bolas inside the crypt

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4560 AR the Second Sun aligns between the horns of the God-Pharaoh's throne and the Gate to the Afterlife opens, unleashing the end of the world for Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Instead of welcoming the God-Pharaoh 's return, this event unleashed the end of the world for Amonkhet .

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "Alignment of the Second Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's deception is revealed as three gods of destruction shatter the Hekma and slay most of the other gods while mummies and Eternals attack.
timeline.quote: Three unknown gods of destruction emerged, shattered the Hekma , and slew most of the other gods.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "Alignment of the Second Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A locust-headed god devours the Hekma's protective magic, letting sands and mummies pour into Naktamun, and the God-Pharaoh appears and mocks the people.
timeline.quote: These locusts devoured the protective magic of the Hekma , tearing down the barrier that kept the desert’s horrors at bay.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas slays Bontu and Hazoret breaks free with her faithful.
timeline.quote: Instead, Bolas slew Bontu himself

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The scarab-headed god leads Bolas's Eternals out of the necropolis.
timeline.quote: These were Bolas 's Eternals : the worthy dead of Naktamun, remade into flawless soldiers

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas shatters Jace's mind and Jace vanishes into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Jace could not resist — and Bolas shattered his mind like glass.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Devastion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas shows Liliana the Chain Veil is no match, shows Nissa that the cycle of life is poisoned, and crushes Chandra in his claws.
timeline.quote: where he snuffed out her fire and crushed her nearly lifeless in his claws.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Devastion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas drives a claw through Gideon's defenses until his invulnerability falters and Gideon flees, leaving Bolas triumphant.
timeline.quote: Bolas drove a claw through Gideon’s defenses until his invulnerability faltered, forcing him to flee as well.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Devastion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Hour of Devastation, Bontu reveals her treachery; Bolas has Bontu bring Hazoret to the God-Pharaoh then kills Bontu, leaving Hazoret the only living god.
timeline.quote: Hazoret now remains the only living god of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The God-Pharaoh Nicol Bolas returns to Amonkhet, and the promised glorious afterlife proves not what everyone thought.
timeline.quote: As promised, the God-Pharaoh has returned.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas comes to claim his perfect zombie army, the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas has come to claim his perfect zombie army, the Eternals .

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is easily defeated by Bolas.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch is easily defeated.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Hour of Devastation, Bolas's Eternal army destroys Naktamun and slays most of its gods; the survivors under Hazoret flee.
timeline.quote: the city was destroyed by the Eternal army of Nicol Bolas, and most of its gods were slain

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas arrives on Amonkhet and corrupts it, killing every adult being.
timeline.quote: he cast a spell that killed every single adult being on the plane

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Invasion of Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas has Bontu killed by the undead after she defeats Hazoret.
timeline.quote: Bolas instead rewarded her with death, forcing numerous undead to tear her apart.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats the Gatewatch on Amonkhet; Gideon, Chandra, Nissa and Liliana flee.
timeline.quote: Gideon fled too, leaving Bolas victorious.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas emerges from a void in the sky and rains black fire on the city and its cheering mortals.
timeline.quote: That was when the dragon raised his hands, and black fire fell from the skies.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut tells the survivors that the God-Pharaoh is a lie and a trespasser, and Masikah doubts her.
timeline.quote: He is a trespasser, an interloper from another world.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert as Bolas flies above, and Djeru and the survivors kneel to her.
timeline.quote: we must simply endure, persist, survive

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas flies toward the five waiting planeswalkers and reflects on his decades of preparation on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: At the edges of the plaza, five planeswalkers stood arrayed against him

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas lands and roars, judging the Gatewatch's simple kill-the-dragon plan.
timeline.quote: They had chosen kill the dragon .

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas swats Gideon against a wall with his tail while ignoring the other attacks.
timeline.quote: Gideon sailed into a thick brick wall lining one side of the plaza.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace attacks Bolas's mind but is lured into a trap and the dragon squeezes his mind.
timeline.quote: The obsidian shield disappeared, and Jace fell unexpectedly into Nicol Bolas's mind.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana, shaken by Jace's scream, is torn between the Chain Veil's urging and the Raven Man's counsel as Bolas taunts her.
timeline.quote: Yes, use us. Unleash your full power

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers to teach Liliana to master the Chain Veil and tells her to go if she wants to live.
timeline.quote: I can help you unlock its power, Liliana.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
timeline.quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra drives Bolas back with white fire for the first time, but he dismisses her as a child.
timeline.quote: he was forced backward for the first time in the fight

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa raises spurs and a giant earth elemental against Bolas, but he crushes Chandra in his claw and shatters her defenses.
timeline.quote: He swooped in and grabbed her in a huge claw.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas strangles Nissa with necrotic tendrils, and she tells Chandra to flee; Chandra planeswalks away injured.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away in a fiery blaze

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas corrupts the leylines Nissa controls, and Gideon's interruption lets her flee the plane.
timeline.quote: She used Gideon's interruption to flee from this dead husk of a world.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas grabs Gideon and pierces his shield and shoulder with a talon, then offers him the choice to stay and die or leave and live.
timeline.quote: the shield parted like melted butter

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives late, and Bolas sends him to fetch Ral Zarek, saying the battle was better than blood.
timeline.quote: Go and tell Ral Zarek to come to me.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas roars, declaring the planar bridge his and the army ready, and steps openly out of the shadows.
timeline.quote: was finally taking his first steps, visibly and openly.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Ugin's summons leads Sarkhan Vol to the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas that seals Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: Ugin's whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to the moment that would echo down the centuries and seal Tarkir's fate: the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: Crux of Fate (Commander 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, reading her mind and offering to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari.
timeline.quote: I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
timeline.quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska accepts, and Bolas bars her from double-crossing him.
timeline.quote: I accept your terms,

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas gives Vraska the thaumatic compass and implants a spell to call his associate and knowledge of sailing.
timeline.quote: It is the thaumatic compass,

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Following Bolas's thaumatic compass, Vraska blunders into the River Heralds' trap.
timeline.quote: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

citation.text: River's Rebuke (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Azor and Ugin meet at the Palace of Justice and devise a plan to get rid of Bolas.
timeline.quote: Together, they devised a plan to get rid of Bolas for good.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his spark, trapping himself and preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Azor created the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his planeswalker's spark

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, Brazen Coalition, Kumena, Huatli, Angrath and Vraska race to Orazca for the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: In the race for Orazca, the planeswalker Angrath joined the fray, as well.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Race". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun in 3279 AR to trap Nicol Bolas, preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Azor created a powerful artifact known as the Immortal Sun to trap Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is stolen and removed from the plane by a henchman of Bolas, breaking the barrier.
timeline.quote: was stolen and removed from the plane by a henchman of Bolas

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace meet Azor, who reveals Ixalan was meant to be Bolas's prison; they plan to infiltrate Bolas's organization.
timeline.quote: Vraska and Jace hatched a plan to infiltrate Bolas' organization

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas gives the Thaumatic Compass to Vraska to find the Immortal Sun in Orazca; she keeps it afterward on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: to assist her in finding the Immortal Sun in the city of Orazca on Ixalan

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine (artifact)", section "Thaumatic Compass". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers to make Vraska guildmaster of the Golgari if she retrieves an item from Orazca on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas offered to make her the guildmaster of the Golgari

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska has Jace remove her memories of him so Bolas cannot read them.
timeline.quote: Vraska asked Jace to remove all her memories of him

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska summons Tezzeret, who spirits the Immortal Sun off the plane, revealing Bolas's plan to invade Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to spirit the Immortal Sun off the plane.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Theft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the plan was to imprison Nicol Bolas, and Jace remembers him.
timeline.quote: Our intention was to imprison Nicol Bolas

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks why Bolas wants a planeswalker prison and Jace says she needs to know who she works for.
timeline.quote: you need to know who you're working for.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Azor he has a plan to free the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Together we will rid the Multiverse of Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas interrogates an elf bureaucrat about the lawbringer and learns of Azor.
timeline.quote: The sphinx was called Azor.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: On another plane Bolas absorbs a lawmage's mind, learning of the plot and killing her.
timeline.quote: listening to him and the Spirit Dragon plot the end of the True Evil

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas appears before Ugin on Tarkir, having followed Azor's clues.
timeline.quote: when his nemesis appeared before him

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas mocks Azor's statues as the reason he was found.
timeline.quote: Your idiot cat is too fond of statues of himself,

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas overpowers Ugin with a swarm of dragon eyes and attackers.
timeline.quote: The Spirit Dragon tried to escape, but was caught in a tempest of fire and claws.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas planeswalks away, believing he has won.
